captions_note: above the head the reel's captions stay on; over the chest the card covers their band, so build.py writes work/reel_captions.json and they step aside only while the card is up
in_a_reel: the chapter clips are the user's own footage (the raw take, the finished reel, a screen recording): put them in <slot>/card/ (fx_new.py --buyer-files <folder>) or give full paths in CHAPTERS
CARD_IN 3 or later, the first chapter 8 frames after it, chapters 12 frames or more apart, CARD_OUT at least 15 frames after the last chapter and 10 before the slot ends
TITLE and chapter names in the user's words; never a number or a claim they did not give
steps: put the user's clips in ./card (or full paths in CHAPTERS), then edit the CLIP block in build.py: TITLE, LABEL, CHAPTERS, CARD_IN, CARD_OUT
run build.py SAFE=1      # measures where the card fits (above the head or over the chest) and prints it

buyer_folder.name: card
buyer_folder.what: the clips for the card's chapters: the user's own raw take, finished reel or screen recording (mp4 / mov). Full paths in CHAPTERS work too
